name: Sapphire of Sky
summary: In Ban'ethil Barrow Den, Sapphire of Sky helps call sleeping Druids of the Talon back from the Emerald Dream. It is one of four sacred Relics of Wakening kept by the night elves.

sections.title: The Wakening Ritual
sections.body: Druids of the Talon sleep in hibernation within Ban'ethil Barrow Den, deep among Teldrassil's roots, while they commune with the wilds. Waking from that deep trance is perilous. Four sacred relics protect the passage: the Black Feather Quill, the Raven Claw Talisman, the Rune of Nesting, and the Sapphire of Sky. The gem completes the harmony needed to call the sleeping spirits back from the Emerald Dream. Without it, they risk being trapped there forever.

sections.title: The Threat in Ban'ethil
sections.body: Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have overrun Ban'ethil Barrow Den, leaving the sacred relics in their repositories. The Sapphire of Sky is secured inside the Chest of the Sky, along the winding underground corridors. The druids still sleep as the furbolgs rampage around them. Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar needs the sapphire and its companion relics to wake the sleepers before they are lost forever.

faq.q: What is the Sapphire of Sky?
faq.answer: Sapphire of Sky is a sacred gemstone and one of four Relics of Wakening kept in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. It works with three avian talismans to guide Druids of the Talon safely out of the Emerald Dream.

faq.q: Where is the Sapphire of Sky kept?
aliases: where to find sapphire of sky
faq.answer: The Sapphire of Sky is kept inside the Chest of the Sky, in the underground labyrinth of Ban'ethil Barrow Den in central Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why is the sapphire needed right now?
faq.answer: Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs have invaded Ban'ethil Barrow Den and put the sleeping druids in grave danger. Deep in trance, the druids cannot simply wake on their own. Athridas Bearmantle needs the sapphire and the other relics for the delicate wakening ritual before the sleepers are lost forever.
The Druids of the Talon and ritual keepers such as Athridas Bearmantle use the sapphire to wake their sleeping brothers from deep communion with nature.

angles.text: As a druid, you can see why sacred anchors matter when your spirit enters the Emerald Dream. Without them, communion can turn fatal.
As a night elf, you know that protecting the sacred relics in Ban'ethil Barrow Den helps preserve Teldrassil's fragile order amid growing corruption.
